name: okta-authn-factor-verify-success
description: A valid synthetic software-factor passcode consumes an MFA_REQUIRED transaction and returns SUCCESS with a one-time session token.
notes: The fixture runner replaces factorId and stateToken from a fresh MFA_REQUIRED response. mockOS accepts the deterministic synthetic code 000000; this is not an RFC 6238 secret, clock-window, enrollment, or TOTP-generation claim.
